principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class has multiple responsibilities: it not only calculates the area of different shapes but also handles the storage and management of the shapes themselves.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibilities of handling the list of shapes and calculating the area into different classes. Create a ShapeContainer class to manage shapes.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class’s sum method needs to be modified for each new shape type, violating the Open/Closed Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use an interface for shapes with an area calculation method. Each shape class should implement this interface. The AreaCalculator can then work polymorphically with the shapes.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
